responsibility: Implements crate-level Rust feature gating on the AST. It parses inner #![feature(...)] attributes into a set of enabled Feature::Name values, rejects unknown feature names, walks crate items, and emits diagnostics when unstable functionality is used without the corresponding gate; in this file the concrete gated check shown is extern blocks using the intrinsic ABI, with diagnostics formatted using metadata from the Feature table.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the feature-gate pair: unlike rust-feature-gate.h, it parses crate-level #![feature(...)] attributes into the enabled-feature set and performs the concrete gated check shown here for intrinsic-ABI extern blocks.
